_comment: Mock-mode topics: the 15 core topics plus the 5 candidates for slots 16-20 (one may be swapped out). topic_id and topic_text come from the team's topic list. Only IDs the survey sends (TOPICS in docs/qualtrics/question.js) can be drawn, so extra corpus topics are harmless. Entries without their own corpus_sources/<topic_id>/ directory are cloned from clone_from's timelines (npm run build:corpus:mock).
